raw_result.classifier_note: The raw harness used the earlier exploratory 1.2x retention threshold. The frozen held-out preregistration makes mean error worse than control an explicit NO_GO, so the preregistered decision below is authoritative. The immutable raw artifact is not overwritten.

interpretation: At equal route12/B16 payload bytes, replacing half of the exact IQ1_S core with additional STQ1_0 gate/up coverage derived from already-quantized IQ1_S weights worsened local routed-output reconstruction on every held-out row. Do not implement an STQ HIP kernel for this cascaded representation.

scope.not_falsified: STQ1_0 calibrated directly from native BF16 with route-aware importance weights
